content.short: Off The Grid is a cyberpunk extraction battle royale developed by Gunzilla Games, featuring NFT-based assets.
content.description:
Off The Grid is a premier cyberpunk-themed extraction battle royale shooter designed by Gunzilla Games, featuring high-action PvP and a rich 60-hour narrative campaign. Built natively on the GUNZ blockchain—a specialized Avalanche L1 subnet—the game brings true digital ownership to mainstream gaming. Players can shoot off and equip unique "cyberlimbs" that provide specialized combat abilities, with every significant in-game item being minted as an NFT for transparent on-chain trading.

Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Neill Blomkamp, Off The Grid bridges the gap between high-fidelity AAA gaming and decentralized technology. The platform leverages Avalanche's high speed and low latency to ensure a seamless competitive experience where player effort is recognized through real-world value. As a milestone title for the Web3 gaming landscape, Off The Grid is empowering millions of players to explore a immersive virtual world where they have total sovereignty over their digital inventory.
content.meta: Off The Grid is a cyberpunk battle royale on Avalanche featuring NFT limb-trading and high-fidelity AAA gameplay.
